output.evaluation_note: The English noun 'least' (meaning 'fewest, smallest number') aligns perfectly with Japanese '最少' (saishō) and Vietnamese 'tối thiểu'. The Hán-Việt origin of 'tối thiểu' (最少) directly corresponds to the Japanese '最少', confirming a strong semantic and etymological link. All expressions are natural, common, and share the same core meaning and part of speech.
